title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode6 A Chance Seized

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: A few days later
Hotel Cafe
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Hello, Suzu. Thank you for inviting me out to have tea with you.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to meet with me, Grandfather.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Hahaha. There's no need to be so formal with me.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Anyway, have you two already ordered?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: I recommend this cafe's seasonal parfaits. They're absolutely superb, and I've fallen completely in love with them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Parfaits...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Didn't your doctor tell you to keep an eye on your sugar intake, Grandfather...?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Yes, and...
I am doing my best to treat myself to dessert only every so often...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is Suzu's grandpa...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He seems a lot nicer than I was expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: I heard that you've been studying management while at Morinomiya, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Y-Yes, that's right. Also, you know about me?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Of course. The Otori children have always been a studious and hardworking bunch in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: So, I couldn't feel more honored that you chose Morinomiya as your place of study.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Now... You're here to discuss the Kikyogumi matter today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Yes.
First, we ask that you take a look at this.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Did you put this together with Emu here, Suzu?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. Otori came up with the base idea, and we worked out the details together.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(He seems like a nice person...
But things feel so tense when he stares into your eyes like this.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, don't look away...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Suzu and I need to convince him that we're serious about this...!)

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Hehe. Intriguing...
This one could turn into something truly special.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Ah, I was just talking to myself.
I only took a quick glance, but the idea has promise.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
...!
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Yes. The board is set to meet one week from now, so you should try presenting it to them then.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: If you manage to convince them, then we'll put it into practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
However, this is all I can say.
The onus will be on you both to convince the rest of the board.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Um, Grandfather?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I love Morinomiya very much.
I want it to keep putting on the best shows a hundred years from now.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In that respect, my feelings are no different from yours or those of anyone else on the board. So...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I promise to convince them.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Good. I'll be looking forward to your presentation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We're going to present our idea to the board...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We have to explain our idea to them and convince them that it's a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Have you ever encountered situations where you had trouble conveying what you were thinking or feeling to someone else?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Just trying my absolute best won't be enough...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to practice communicating my ideas!)
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait, say that again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I need you to teach me how to give good presentations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Like the ones you guys give for work!
I wanna learn how to do that!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Like the ones we give for work...?
When do you have to present your idea, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In a week!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
A week...?!
You're joking, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I absolutely have to figure out how to convince everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I need to speak effectively and make the right gestures... If I don't take how people will see me into consideration, then they're probably not going to understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know this is really hard and that I'm asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm sure that I need to do this if I'm gonna turn this dream into a reality! I want to give a good presentation!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Sounds like you're serious...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If you're that motivated, then there's no harm in acquiring some public speaking skills.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yeah, this is a good chance to do that.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We'll teach you everything you need to know, and you'll be giving presentations that can change any naysayer's mind in no time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. So, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, you guys!
